# KELA | Messages from the Trees

> KELA is the original spiritual-reflection work of Tree Medium Patti, published by Lumen Pleroma LLC. The site offers free online animal, tree, and plant oracle cards, nature memory games, and a private Tree Message service. Its nature-based oracle experience is distinct from traditional tarot.

## Primary pages

- [Free Online Oracle Cards](https://treemedium.vercel.app/): Draw a free animal, tree, or plant oracle card online with no signup; an original nature-based alternative to tarot.
- [Meet Tree Medium Patti](https://treemedium.vercel.app/meet-patti): Patti's story, the KELA presence, private Tree Messages, and booking.

## Interactive experiences

- [Free Animal Oracle Card Online](https://treemedium.vercel.app/animal-oracle)
- [Free Tree Oracle Card Online](https://treemedium.vercel.app/tree-oracle)
- [Free Plant Oracle Card Online](https://treemedium.vercel.app/plant-oracle)
- [Free Nature Memory Games](https://treemedium.vercel.app/memory-games)
- [Animal Guide Bug Quest](https://treemedium.vercel.app/animal-adventure)

## Important context

- Each revealed KELA card offers an original interpretation for spiritual reflection and personal growth.
- They do not claim universal, Indigenous, religious, supernatural, or medical authority.
- Oracle content is not a prediction, diagnosis, treatment, or command.
- No plant card is advice to ingest or apply a plant.
- Contact: treemedium@proton.me
